d:
Kuch nahin badla deewane the deewane hi rahe
hum naye shahron mein rah kar bhi purane hi rahe
• Iqbal Ashhar
He is an eminent Urdu language poet born in Delhi, having a regular presence at mushairas. He is the author of the famous poetical composition Urdu Hai Mera Naam, Mein Khusro ki Paheli. He is also known for the mystical touch he imparts to his poetry.
